source_policy: Repository fixtures and transient generated fixtures only. Do not copy customer or project drawings into this matrix.

cases.question: Check GRID-A1 structural references
known_limitations: Synthetic fixture validates anchor retrieval, not structural correctness.

cases.question: Review grid and member tags for structural anchors
known_limitations: Generated large fixture exercises evidence caps and compact output size, not CAD rendering quality.

cases.question: Review unsupported content before relying on drawing evidence
known_limitations: Partial import must stay visible; it must not be summarized as all clear.

cases.question: Review missing source behavior
known_limitations: No artifacts are expected because no source was loaded.

cases.question: Review unsupported DWG behavior
known_limitations: Unsupported modern DWG versions remain intentionally blocked until a clean-room reader contract is approved.

cases.question: Review drawing changes
known_limitations: Comparison differences remain review evidence, not issue conclusions.

cases.question: Review drawing changes
known_limitations: No comparison evidence does not mean the drawing is approved.

false_positive_backlog.risk: A no-change comparison could be misread as final approval if wording drifts.
false_positive_backlog.current_guard: Summary wording avoids approval/release language and safety scan blocks positive action phrases.
false_positive_backlog.next_improvement: Add domain reviewer examples for no-change comparison wording.

false_positive_backlog.risk: Nearby context in dense drawings may include unrelated adjacent tags.
false_positive_backlog.current_guard: Nearby entities are capped at 8 and returned as context only.
false_positive_backlog.next_improvement: Add sheet region or viewport-aware proximity filtering.

false_negative_backlog.risk: Unsupported entity geometry can hide real structural anchors.
false_negative_backlog.current_guard: Partial source health and unsupported content review suggestion are emitted.
false_negative_backlog.next_improvement: Expand importer coverage only with bounded diagnostics and no raw payload exposure.

false_negative_backlog.risk: Modern DWG sources currently cannot provide drawing anchors.
false_negative_backlog.current_guard: Unsupported source health and clean-room blocking stage are explicit.
false_negative_backlog.next_improvement: Implement approved clean-room section-map reader before enabling evidence extraction.
